name: FIREGUARD
description: Wildfire intelligence demo: detect → confirm → predict → protect (public excerpt)

paragraphs: This is a DEMO of a real, working software project. It shows how FireGuard would operate when deployed: it is built on real data APIs (satellite hotspots, geostationary fire radiative power, live weather, OpenStreetMap, official Catalan fire records) and a camera → AI smoke-detection pipeline. Parts of the scenario are deliberately simulated and labelled DEMO / SYNTHETIC on screen — see What is real vs. simulated. This repository is a public excerpt, not the full product. Credentials, private infrastructure and the proprietary models were deliberately excluded — see Intellectual property.
FireGuard is a wildfire command center. It fuses several independent signals on a single map to tell an operator where a fire is, whether it is real, where it is going, and who is in its path:
